notes.title: Relic Guardians: Complete Edition is out NOW!!
notes.content:
After a year and a half of hard work, a lot of testing and plenty of sweat and blood, I can finally release [b]Relic Guardians: Complete Edition[/b]!

Why "[i]Complete Edition[/i]" you may ask. It's the fusion of the [b]Arcade Version[/b] released in January on Newgrounds (+ bonus characters and endings) and the [b]Story Version[/b] released in February on Oximaru Studios' YouTube Channel (+ english dialogue, revised text and a few extra scenes).

The game is pretty [i]unusual [/i]if I'm being completely honest, but I'm pretty confident it can be plenty of fun for the right people. So I really hope you enjoy it. And if you really like it, feel free to share it with any friend you think it would like it too!

Thanks so much for your patronage and time!
Enjoy it!
